Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.3: Language use 4.3.1 Singular and plurals (add -s and -es)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language use 4.3.1 Singular and plurals (add -s and -es), part of Strand 4 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do we show that an item is one or many?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language use 4.3.1 Singular and plurals (add -s and -es) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital literacy- The learner’s ability to create with technology is enhanced as they recite and record poems containing singular and plural nouns.

Values:
Responsibility is enhanced as learners take different roles in group activities.

Pertinent Contemporary Issues:

Citizenship-social cohesion is enhanced as learners work together in groups cooperatively.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner applies the knowledge on singular and plural nouns to learning of similar concept in Kiswahili and Indigenous Language Activities.

Suggested learning resources

• Braille letter cards

• Textbooks in braille and in appropriate font and colour contrast
